lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਹਿ ਬਲੰਦੜੀ ਬੁਝਿ ਗਈ ਰਖੰਦੜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaahi bala(n)daRee bujh gaee rakha(n)daRo prabh aap ||
lines.translation: The burning fire has been put out; God Himself has saved me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਮੇਦਨੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jin upaaee medanee naanak so prabh jaap ||2||
lines.translation: Meditate on that God, O Nanak, who created the universe. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa prabh bhae daiaal na biaapai maaiaa ||
lines.translation: When God becomes merciful, Maya does not cling.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਅਘਾ ਗਏ ਨਾਸ ਹਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kot aghaa gae naas har ik dhiaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Millions of sins are eliminated, by meditating on the Naam, the Name of the One Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਭਏ ਸਰੀਰ ਜਨ ਧੂਰੀ ਨਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: niramal bhae sareer jan dhooree naaiaa ||
lines.translation: The body is made immaculate and pure, bathing in the dust of the feet of the Lord's humble servants.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਭਏ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan bhae sa(n)tokh pooran prabh paaiaa ||
lines.translation: The mind and body become contented, finding the Perfect Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਰੇ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸੰਗਿ ਲੋਗ ਕੁਲ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੧੮॥
lines.transliteration: tare kuta(n)b sa(n)g log kul sabaaiaa ||18||
lines.translation: One is saved, along with his family, and all his ancestors. ||18||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੁਰ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਨਾਰਾਇਣਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur gobi(n)d gopaal gur gur pooran naaraainah ||
lines.translation: The Guru is the Lord of the Universe; the Guru is the Lord of the world; the Guru is the Perfect Pervading Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਦਇਆਲ ਸਮਰਥ ਗੁਰ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣਹ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur daiaal samarath gur gur naanak patit udhaaranah ||1||
lines.translation: The Guru is compassionate; the Guru is all-powerful; the Guru, O Nanak, is the Saving Grace of sinners. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਉਜਲੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਅਸਗਾਹੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਬੋਹਿਥੈ ਤਾਰਿਅਮੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaujal bikham asagaahu gur bohithai taariam ||
lines.translation: The Guru is the boat, to cross over the dangerous, treacherous, unfathomable world-ocean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰ ਕਰੰਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਗਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak poor kara(n)m satigur charanee lagiaa ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, by perfect good karma, one is attached to the feet of the True Guru. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਜਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dha(n)n dha(n)n guradev jis sa(n)g har jape ||
lines.translation: Blessed, blessed is the Divine Guru; associating with Him, one meditates on the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਜਬ ਭਏ ਤ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਸਭਿ ਛਪੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kripaal jab bhae ta avagun sabh chhape ||
lines.translation: When the Guru becomes merciful, then all one's demerits are dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਨੀਚਹੁ ਉਚ ਥਪੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: paarabraham guradev neechahu uch thape ||
lines.translation: The Supreme Lord God, the Divine Guru, uplifts and exalts the lowly.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਟਿ ਸਿਲਕ ਦੁਖ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਅਪ ਦਸੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaat silak dukh maaiaa kar leene ap dase ||
lines.translation: Cutting away the painful noose of Maya, He makes us His own slaves.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੇ ॥੧੯॥
lines.transliteration: gun gaae bea(n)t rasanaa har jase ||19||
lines.translation: With my tongue, I sing the Glorious Praises of the infinite Lord God. ||19||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੰਤ ਏਕੋ ਸੁਨੀਅੰਤ ਏਕੋ ਵਰਤੰਤ ਏਕੋ ਨਰਹਰਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: drisata(n)t eko suneea(n)t eko varata(n)t eko naraharah ||
lines.translation: I see only the One Lord; I hear only the One Lord; the One Lord is all-pervading.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਜਾਚੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naam daan jaacha(n)t naanak daiaal purakh kripaa karah ||1||
lines.translation: Nanak begs for the gift of the Naam; O Merciful Lord God, please grant Your Grace. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਿਕੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਹਿਕੁ ਸੰਮਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਇਕਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: hik sevee hik sa(n)malaa har ikas pahi aradaas ||
lines.translation: I serve the One Lord, I contemplate the One Lord, and to the One Lord, I offer my prayer.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਵਖਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naam vakhar dhan sa(n)chiaa naanak sachee raas ||2||
lines.translation: Nanak has gathered in the wealth, the merchandise of the Naam; this is the true capital. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਇਆਲ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਪੂਰਨ ਇਕੁ ਏਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh daiaal bea(n)t pooran ik ehu ||
lines.translation: God is merciful and infinite. The One and Only is all-pervading.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਕਹਾ ਕੇਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh aape aap doojaa kahaa kehu ||
lines.translation: He Himself is all-in-all. Who else can we speak of?

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਲੇਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap karahu prabh daan aape aap lehu ||
lines.translation: God Himself grants His gifts, and He Himself receives them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਥੇਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavan jaanaa hukam sabh nihachal tudh thehu ||
lines.translation: Coming and going are all by the Hukam of Your Will; Your place is steady and unchanging.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ॥੨੦॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak ma(n)gai daan kar kirapaa naam dehu ||20||1||
lines.translation: Nanak begs for this gift; by Your Grace, Lord, please grant me Your Name. ||20||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaitasaree baanee bhagataa kee ||
lines.translation: Jaitsree, The Word Of The Devotees:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਥ ਕਛੂਅ ਨ ਜਾਨਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: naath kachhoo na jaanau ||
lines.translation: O my Lord and Master, I know nothing.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਹਾਥਿ ਬਿਕਾਨਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: man maaiaa kai haath bikaanau ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: My mind has sold out, and is in Maya's hands. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਕਹੀਅਤ ਹੌ ਜਗਤ ਗੁਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: tum kaheeat hau jagat gur suaamee ||
lines.translation: You are called the Lord and Master, the Guru of the World.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਕਹੀਅਤ ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਕੇ ਕਾਮੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ham kaheeat kalijug ke kaamee ||1||
lines.translation: I am called a lustful being of the Dark Age of Kali Yuga. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਨ ਪੰਚਨ ਮੇਰੋ ਮਨੁ ਜੁ ਬਿਗਾਰਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: in pa(n)chan mero man j bigaario ||
lines.translation: The five vices have corrupted my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਲੁ ਪਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਤੇ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਪਾਰਿਓ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: pal pal har jee te a(n)tar paario ||2||
lines.translation: Moment by moment, they lead me further away from the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਤ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਤ ਦੁਖ ਕੀ ਰਾਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jat dekhau tat dukh kee raasee ||
lines.translation: Wherever I look, I see loads of pain and suffering.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਜੌਂ ਨ ਪਤੵਾਇ ਨਿਗਮ ਭਏ ਸਾਖੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ajau(n) na patyaai nigam bhae saakhee ||3||
lines.translation: I do not have faith, even though the Vedas bear witness to the Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੋਤਮ ਨਾਰਿ ਉਮਾਪਤਿ ਸ੍ਵਾਮੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gotam naar umaapat svaamee ||
lines.translation: Shiva cut off Brahma's head, and Gautam's wife and the Lord Indra mated;

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੀਸੁ ਧਰਨਿ ਸਹਸ ਭਗ ਗਾਂਮੀ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: sees dharan sahas bhag gaa(n)mee ||4||
lines.translation: Brahma's head got stuck to Shiva's hand, and Indra came to bear the marks of a thousand female organs. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਨ ਦੂਤਨ ਖਲੁ ਬਧੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਰਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: in dootan khal badh kar maario ||
lines.translation: These demons have fooled, bound and destroyed me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਡੋ ਨਿਲਾਜੁ ਅਜਹੂ ਨਹੀ ਹਾਰਿਓ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: bado nilaaj ajahoo nahee haario ||5||
lines.translation: I am very shameless - even now, I am not tired of them. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਕਹਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahi ravidaas kahaa kaise keejai ||
lines.translation: Says Ravi Daas, what am I to do now?

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਰਘੁਨਾਥ ਸਰਨਿ ਕਾ ਕੀ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੬॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bin raghunaath saran kaa kee leejai ||6||1||
lines.translation: Without the Sanctuary of the Lord's Protection, who else's should I seek? ||6||1||
